name: cancer-buddy
description: 抗癌搭子 — CancerDAO's patient-facing AI cancer companion. A meta-skill plus companion sub-skills (record organize, nutrition, find-care, caregiver, education, disclosure, second-opinion, vault) that walk a patient and their family through the cancer journey. Does not perform mental-health screening or crisis intervention. Never fabricates medical facts; doctors, hospitals, trials, and citations must trace to a live source.
author: CancerDAO
